title: ABBA Intent Mission Uncertainty Stewardship Contract
rules: Explicit human intent outranks inferred intent when compatible with Canon and valid authority boundaries.
Inferred intent never silently becomes explicit human intent.
Ambiguous intent is surfaced for clarification rather than guessed through consequential execution.
Every mission has explicit success criteria or is marked incomplete.
Assumptions are recorded separately from evidence.
Unknown, ambiguous, contradictory, provisional, stale and missing evidence remain explicit uncertainty states.
Mission decomposition may propose tasks but does not authorize execution.
Capability provenance is evaluated separately from permission and authority.
Outcome simulation is analysis, not evidence of what will happen.
Stewardship considers value, cost, waste, risk, human impact, environmental impact, reversibility and continuity.
No reasoning or planning artifact grants authority.
executionBoundary: All consequential tasks exit through the existing Authority + Policy + Consent Gate.
